messages:
Maya: heads-up — nightly-eval flagged a surge in hallucinations for rwd-3b int8 on the long-answer suite. samples show invented citations and bogus dates. :eyes:
Raj: which eval run id? can you paste a failing sample?
Maya: run eval-1983 (2026-03-19T04:12Z). sample below:
```
Prompt: Explain the causes of the 1830s banking panic.
Response: The 1830s banking panic was primarily caused by the War of 1812 and the decrees of the London Fiscal Council in 1832. See: Journal of Historical Finance, 1997.
```
Oliver: that citation is fabricated. i was able to repro locally when using int8-dyn path. model: rwd-3b@v2.3, quant: int8-dyn-kernelX. artifact: https://artifacts.internal/rwd/evals/eval-1983/logs
EvalBot: ALERT metric: hallucination_rate_long_answers from 0.8% -> 7.4% (p<0.001) for model rwd-3b@v2.3 int8-dyn.
Sarah: fyi i merged kernel-selection change (PR #2412) yesterday that changes preferred attention kernel for int8. might be interaction. :thinking_face:
Raj: sounds plausible. can someone run a bisect between v2.2 and v2.3 focusing on kernel selection + quant path?
Maya: i'm launching a narrow repro job with 100 prompts from the failing set, running 10 seeds on dev-gpu. will post samples.
Oliver: attaching short log snippet from my local repro:
```
E 2026-03-19 04:13:22 kv_cache: mismatch seq_len 1024 vs 2048
W 2026-03-19 04:13:23 kernelX: fallback to slow-path for batch size 1
```
Raj: kv_cache mismatch + kernel fallback could explain stale context leading to invented facts. @Sarah can you try reverting just the kernel-selection change on a canary build?
Sarah: yes, will spin a canary with kernel-selection reverted on int8-dyn. if it repros there, we revert in canary rollout.
Maya: quick check: the failing outputs consistently include fabricated citations like 'Journal of Historical Finance, 1997' across seeds. looks deterministic with that kernel+quant combo.
Oliver: started a trace capture and uploaded to s3://rwd-evals/traces/1938202468. also saved raw token streams to s3://rwd-evals/outputs/1938202468
Raj: action items: (1) Maya: finish repro and paste failing sample ids (2) Oliver: diff quant config + kernel flags used in canary vs baseline (3) Sarah: test kernel revert on canary int8-dyn (4) Raj: prepare rollback PR if confirmed.
Sarah: running canary now, ETA ~30m. will report back. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maya: will also run the same prompt set on unquantized (fp16) baseline to confirm regression is quant-path specific.
Oliver: if confirmed, we'll pin int8 to old kernel for Dedicated until patch.
Raj: good. if anyone sees new weird outputs post-revert, flag in incidents immediately. :fire:
Maya: posting updates in ~45m. thanks all.
